preflight.title: System Check

preflight.macosNative: macOS: EMsoft + EMSphInx build natively (no WSL required)
preflight.appleSilicon: Apple Silicon: OpenCL via Apple GPU (no NVIDIA)
preflight.intelMac: Intel Mac: OpenCL via Apple framework
preflight.linuxNative: Native Linux: EMsoft installs directly — no WSL required
preflight.driverTooOld: NVIDIA driver {{driver}} is too old for WSL2 GPU support. Please update to version 470+ from nvidia.com/drivers.
preflight.noNvidia: No NVIDIA GPU detected. EMsoft simulations will use CPU-only mode (slower). If you have an NVIDIA GPU, update your Windows driver from nvidia.com/drivers.
preflight.wsl1Warning: WSL is running in version 1 (no GPU support). Upgrade to WSL 2: open PowerShell as admin and run: wsl --set-version <distro> 2

report.title: Report a problem
report.prompt: What were you doing, and what did you expect to happen instead?
report.placeholder: e.g. Loaded SampleB, started Hough indexing on the whole map — it stopped at 40% and the phase map stayed empty. I expected a finished map.
report.contents: The report contains: your description, what the app did in the last minutes, the app version, environment and package versions, and the log files. It contains NO measurement data. Nothing is sent automatically — you get a file to attach.
report.done: Report saved. Please attach the file to your bug report.

update.title: Update available
update.whatHappens: Orienta will download the new version, install any changed packages, rebuild the interface and then restart. This can take a few minutes. If anything fails, your current version stays in place.
update.manualHow: It was set up from a downloaded archive rather than a git clone, so there is nothing to update from. Download the new version and follow the install steps in INSTALL.md, or ask for a git-based installation to get automatic updates.
update.doNotClose: Please leave this window open until the update has finished.
update.doneMessage: Update installed. Restart to use the new version.
update.failedSafe: Nothing was changed — the previous version is still installed and working.
update.checkOnStart: Check for updates when Orienta starts
